check_definitions.candidate: Candidate validation utility equals admission candidate_utility, and per-round val_reg where present.
check_definitions.retained_best: Post-decision best_utility from the admission journal; accepted ties can change best_round without changing utility.
check_definitions.program_events: kind=promotion, CV gate passed and new-minus-old utility >0.000001; historical admissions excluded.
check_definitions.rates: Recompute counts divided by total retained wall seconds, not the mean of per-round rates.
check_definitions.margins: Exact Decimal candidate minus previous best; exact bins, median, closest rejection and trailing50 linear-interpolation quantiles.
check_definitions.selection_counts: Both plotted series equal the per-round fixed-reference identity counts; 91 contexts and reference round882. Counts do not establish quality or training causality.
check_definitions.comparison_tolerance: Raw logged scalar matches and counts use exact Decimal/int comparisons; float-derived rate/shortfall comparisons use rel_tol1e-12, abs_tol1e-14.
check_definitions.history: Retained historical aggregate metadata hashes match its provenance;159groups/55pairs/64lowergroups/23pairs and reported first final-value generations replay. Original score/seed payloads are not reopened.

appendices.A: Native family-allocation source is distinguished from qualification of any corpus or checkpoint.
appendices.B: Exclusion and pending audit requirements do not establish completed benchmark qualification.
appendices.C: Encoder, native objectives, registered parameter counts and optimization records are explicitly historical reference specifications; exercised/learned capacity is not inferred.
appendices.D: Adapter-only decisions and program events retain separate denominators and adaptive development scope. Predicted ranking cost is distinct from logged utility.
appendices.E: Program-event clocks include all completed-round work/waits; no independent writer or value-net result is asserted.
appendices.F: Strict-event gain distribution is conditional/descriptive; no-event rounds are counted separately, no independent performance/uncertainty estimate inferred.

caption_and_figure_review.method: Caption/label source and extracted PDF figure text read; experiment-like identifiers searched and findings reviewed.

limitations: The per-round audit starts at883; earlier candidate/admission records use the companion admission journal starting775.
Program-event counts use promotion records, excluding historical admissions.
Duration arithmetic is recomputed from pinned retained CSV rows; old rotating summary rows are not claimed newly observed.
Historical search aggregates are separate retained metadata, not the live per-round series.
